# cubepath_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a Cloud Alerts rule: notifies the given channels when a metric of a VPS, baremetal server or availability group crosses a threshold for a sustained time. Import with the rule ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the channels to notify (cubepath_alert_channel), 1 to 10.
- `metric_type` (String) Metric: cpu, ram, disk, network_in or network_out. Baremetal servers only support network_in and network_out.
- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization: up to 128 letters, numbers, spaces and hyphens.
- `operator` (String) Comparison: gt, gte, lt, lte or eq.
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID. Changing it forces a new rule.
- `target_id` (String) ID of the VPS or baremetal server, or UUID of the availability group.
- `target_type` (String) What the rule watches: vps, baremetal or availability_group.
- `threshold` (Number) Threshold, 0 to 1000000 (percent for cpu, ram and disk).

### Optional

- `cooldown_seconds` (Number) Minimum time between two notifications, 60 to 86400. Defaults to 600.
- `description` (String) Description, up to 500 characters.
- `duration_seconds` (Number) How long the condition must hold before the rule fires, 60 to 3600. Defaults to 300.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is evaluated. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the rule.
- `status` (String) Current status: enabled, disabled, triggered or resolved.
